run_string_headers_generator: run the script to generate Boost.Metaparse string header files for a given boost directory
generate_boost_metaparse_string_hpp: generate the string.hpp header file with macro definitions for a specified maximum length limit
generate_take_function: generate the constexpr take function that computes string length using binary step decomposition
generate_make_string_template: generate the make_string template struct with recursive concatenation for compile-time string parsing
generate_length_limits: generate a list of zero-padded length limit strings from a max limit and step size
